scripts.build:consumer: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.consumer.config.ts && node scripts/verify-consumer-build.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build:producer && npm run build:consumer && npm run build:pharmacy
scripts.db:init:local: wrangler d1 execute signalcode --local --config wrangler.pharmacy.jsonc --file db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute signalcode --local --config wrangler.pharmacy.jsonc --file db/seed.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: wrangler d1 execute signalcode --remote --config wrangler.pharmacy.jsonc --file db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute signalcode --remote --config wrangler.pharmacy.jsonc --file db/seed.sql
scripts.deploy:pharmacy: npm run build:pharmacy && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.pharmacy.jsonc
scripts.deploy:producer: npm run build:producer && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:consumer: npm run build:consumer && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.consumer.jsonc
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:all && npm run ci:deploy:producer && npm run ci:deploy:consumer && npm run ci:deploy:pharmacy
